notes: Reports no longer arrive as download.zip when another extension is installed. Two causes, both fixed: the Shopee twin was answering Chrome about these downloads while asleep, and this extension had one path where it answered blank about its own file - which tells Chrome to use the name it guessed from the link. It now stays silent unless it has a real name to give.
A file Chrome renamed no longer fails the report. The data goes to ProfitLens from memory, so the import now finishes and the popup says where the file actually landed.
